methods.label: Interior-angle sum formula
methods.explanation: The sum of the interior angles of an \(n\)-gon is \((n-2)\times180^\circ\). Thus, \((8-2)\times180=1080\).
methods.levelReason: This directly applies the Grade 8 polygon interior-angle sum formula.
